SuperHair® is your multivitamin for hair magic.
Our clinical strength hair supplement promotes healthier, thicker, stronger hair 4 ways.* 10 bioavailable vitamins make up a comprehensive multivitamin to address the nutritional deficiencies that inhibit the growth of healthy hair.* Adaptogens like ashwagandha help balance stress hormones that can contribute to thinning and hair loss.* Botanicals like saw palmetto support healthy hair follicles and promote thickness, and micronutrients promote hair strength and smooth texture.* Commit to SuperHair® daily, and you should start to see hair health results in 90 days.*
Commit to SuperHair® daily, and you should start to see hair health results in 4 weeks.* Recurring subscription orders are fulfilled with compostable pouches to refill your original bottle.
HOW SUPERHAIR STACKS UP
*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.


MULTIVITAMINS+ Bioavailable Vitamins: Vitamin A, six Vitamin B's, Vitamin C, Vitamin D, Vitamin E, and Vitamin K address the nutritional deficiencies that inhibit the growth of healthy hair*
ADAPTOGEN+ Organic Ashwagandha: helps balance stress hormones and reduce the effects of oxidative stress, which can contribute to hair loss*
FOLLICLE PROTECTORS+ Saw Palmetto & Pumpkin Seed: help inhibit the hair-destructive hormone, DHT, to support healthy hair follicles and promote thickness*
MICRONUTRIENTS+ Horsetail: provides silica, for hair strength and thickness.*+ Biotin: supports healthy keratin infrastructure — linked to smooth texture.*+ Kelp: rich in iodine and essential for endocrine and thyroid hormone balance — imbalance can contribute to hair loss*
*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.


Take 4 caps of SuperHair® every morning, with or without food, for healthier, thicker, stronger hair.*


Vitamin A (as Vitamin A Palmitate), Vitamin C (as Ascorbic Acid), Vitamin D3 (as Vitashine D3™ Cholecalciferol), Vitamin E (as D-alpha Tocopherol), Vitamin B1 (Thiamin as B complex), Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin as B complex), Vitamin B3 (Niacin as B complex), Vitamin B6 (as B complex), Folate (as L-methylfolate Calcium (Metafolin®), B complex), Vitamin B12 (as Methylcobalamin), B complex), Biotin, Vitamin B5 (Pantothenic Acid as B Complex), Iron (as Iron Bisglycinate), Iodine (as Organic Kelp (Laminaria digitata) Powder), Pumpkin (Cucurbita moschata) (Seed) Powder, Organic Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) Root Extract (KSM-66®), Horsetail (Equisetum arvense L.) (Grass) Extract, Saw Palmetto (Serenoa repens) (Fruit) Extract, B Complex (Guava (Psidium guajava) (Fruit) Extract, Holy Basil (Ocimum sanctum) (Leaf) Extract, Lemon (Citrus limon) (Fruit Peel) Extract), Vitamin K2 (From MK-7),  Vegetable Capsule (Hypromellose), Organic Rice Concentrate, Rice Bran Wax. 


Our ingredients are 100% traceable, unadulterated, and sustainably sourced.

+ All vitamins are bioavailable, bioactive, and USP grade.
+ Ashwagandha from organic farms in India.
+ Kelp wild harvested from a kelp forest in Iceland.

+ Horsetail hand harvested from Spain.
+ Saw Palmetto wildcrafted from the U.S.
